title: Back to Purple Mountain
summary: Ye Fan and Ji Ziyue reunite after twelve years, and Ji Haoyue warns that Ye Fan should leave if he sees her only as a neighbour's sister. The friends share news: Yuan Gu has hunted Pang Bo for years for the Demon Emperor's Nine Executions, with the Red Dragon Daoist shielding him until Pang Bo vanished, and the Heavenly Emperor's Son's line has hunted the monkey, Sheng Huangzi. Divine Spirit Valley sends a message across the land that the Holy Body must come and kneel, or the barbarian tribe will be wiped out first. The tribe vows to fight, but Ye Fan answers alone, bluffing that a human Great Emperor is about to return. He sends Li Tian to the valley with a jade pendant recording the 'Mad Emperor' (the Old Madman) killing three Great Saints on an extraterritorial battlefield, and the Divine Spirit Valley Ancestral King (Saint realm) is shaken to see what looks like Quasi-Emperor power. At the Demon race's Immortal Palace in Demon City, the Red Dragon Daoist (Immortal Platform 3rd Heaven) says the Qing Jiao King died two years ago and lends Ye Fan a Saint-level Holy Body corpse from the late king's treasury. Leaving his real body with Qing Yi, Ye Fan wears the corpse into Purple Mountain, hoping to find Great Emperor Wu Shi's contingency. There he runs into Duan De and the Blind Old Man of Heaven (Second Great Bandit of the North, 3rd Heaven), and the three pass through a Yin-Yang reversed death gate, a mini star domain and a black hole by sheltering inside the corpse's Bitter Sea, reaching the depths of the mountain.
